p.src: 1  Ask of the LORD rain in the spring time, the LORD who makes storm clouds, and he gives rain showers to everyone for the plants in the field.

ja: は雷雲を造り、 すべての
en: Ask of the LORD rain in the spring time, the LORD who makes storm clouds, and he gives rain showers to everyone for the plants in the field.
u.src: 1  Ask of the LORD rain in the spring time, the LORD who makes storm clouds, and he gives rain showers to everyone for the plants in the field.

p.src: 2  For the teraphim have spoken vanity, and the diviners have seen a lie; and they have told false dreams. They comfort in vain. Therefore they go their way like sheep. They are oppressed, because there is no shepherd.

ja: テラフィム は空しいことを
らの慰めはむなしい。 それゆえ、人々は
のようにさまよい、 羊飼いがいないために
en: For the teraphim have spoken vanity, and the diviners have seen a lie; and they have told false dreams. They comfort in vain. Therefore they go their way like sheep. They are oppressed, because there is no shepherd.
u.src: 2  For the teraphim have spoken vanity, and the diviners have seen a lie; and they have told false dreams. They comfort in vain. Therefore they go their way like sheep. They are oppressed, because there is no shepherd.

ja: 10:2 テラフィムは家の偶像であり、家の財産の相続権と関係していた可能性がある。
en: 10:2 teraphim were household idols that may have been associated with inheritance rights to the household property.

p.src: 3  My anger is kindled against the shepherds, and I will punish the male goats, for the LORD of Armies has visited his flock, the house of Judah, and will make them as his majestic horse in the battle.

ja: のようにされるからだ。
en: My anger is kindled against the shepherds, and I will punish the male goats, for the LORD of Armies has visited his flock, the house of Judah, and will make them as his majestic horse in the battle.
u.src: 3  My anger is kindled against the shepherds, and I will punish the male goats, for the LORD of Armies has visited his flock, the house of Judah, and will make them as his majestic horse in the battle.

p.src: 4  From him will come the cornerstone, from him the tent peg, from him the battle bow, from him every ruler together.

ja: が出て、 彼から天幕の
が出て、 彼からすべての
en: From him will come the cornerstone, from him the tent peg, from him the battle bow, from him every ruler together.
u.src: 4  From him will come the cornerstone, from him the tent peg, from him the battle bow, from him every ruler together.

p.src: 5  They will be as mighty men, treading down muddy streets in the battle. They will fight, because the LORD is with them. The riders on horses will be confounded.

ja: らとともにおられるので、
en: They will be as mighty men, treading down muddy streets in the battle. They will fight, because the LORD is with them. The riders on horses will be confounded.
u.src: 5  They will be as mighty men, treading down muddy streets in the battle. They will fight, because the LORD is with them. The riders on horses will be confounded.

p.src: 6  “I will strengthen the house of Judah, and I will save the house of Joseph. I will bring them back, for I have mercy on them. They will be as though I had not cast them off, for I am the LORD their God, and I will hear them.

ja: らは、私に捨てられたことがなかったかのようになる。 私は
en: “I will strengthen the house of Judah, and I will save the house of Joseph. I will bring them back, for I have mercy on them. They will be as though I had not cast them off, for I am the LORD their God, and I will hear them.
u.src: 6  “I will strengthen the house of Judah, and I will save the house of Joseph. I will bring them back, for I have mercy on them. They will be as though I had not cast them off, for I am the LORD their God, and I will hear them.

p.src: 7  Ephraim will be like a mighty man, and their heart will rejoice as through wine. Yes, their children will see it and rejoice. Their heart will be glad in the LORD.

ja: のようになり、 その
en: Ephraim will be like a mighty man, and their heart will rejoice as through wine. Yes, their children will see it and rejoice. Their heart will be glad in the LORD.
u.src: 7  Ephraim will be like a mighty man, and their heart will rejoice as through wine. Yes, their children will see it and rejoice. Their heart will be glad in the LORD.

p.src: 8  I will signal for them and gather them, for I have redeemed them. They will increase as they were before.

en: I will signal for them and gather them, for I have redeemed them. They will increase as they were before.
u.src: 8  I will signal for them and gather them, for I have redeemed them. They will increase as they were before.

p.src: 9  I will sow them among the peoples. They will remember me in far countries. They will live with their children and will return.

ja: の間に種のようにまく。
en: I will sow them among the peoples. They will remember me in far countries. They will live with their children and will return.
u.src: 9  I will sow them among the peoples. They will remember me in far countries. They will live with their children and will return.

p.src: 10  I will bring them again also out of the land of Egypt, and gather them out of Assyria. I will bring them into the land of Gilead and Lebanon; and there won’t be room enough for them.

ja: し、 アッシリアから
らをギルアデとレバノンの
en: I will bring them again also out of the land of Egypt, and gather them out of Assyria. I will bring them into the land of Gilead and Lebanon; and there won’t be room enough for them.
u.src: 10  I will bring them again also out of the land of Egypt, and gather them out of Assyria. I will bring them into the land of Gilead and Lebanon; and there won’t be room enough for them.

p.src: 11  He will pass through the sea of affliction, and will strike the waves in the sea, and all the depths of the Nile will dry up; and the pride of Assyria will be brought down, and the scepter of Egypt will depart.

ja: がり、 アッシリアの
りは引き下ろされ、 エジプトの
en: He will pass through the sea of affliction, and will strike the waves in the sea, and all the depths of the Nile will dry up; and the pride of Assyria will be brought down, and the scepter of Egypt will depart.
u.src: 11  He will pass through the sea of affliction, and will strike the waves in the sea, and all the depths of the Nile will dry up; and the pride of Assyria will be brought down, and the scepter of Egypt will depart.

p.src: 12  I will strengthen them in the LORD. They will walk up and down in his name,” says the LORD.

en: I will strengthen them in the LORD. They will walk up and down in his name,” says the LORD.
